raw.setBoundary: Count how many engineers you lead when you just started your new role, and how many engineers you lead now.
raw.missingRisk: If the transition timing ("just started") is defined differently in other sessions not provided, we may misalign which historical count corresponds to that start date; also the wording may refer to overlapping timeframes (e.g., at start vs later after growth).

items.why: States the baseline/start count: "I lead a team of 4 engineers in my new role as Senior Software Engineer." This supports the "just started" number.
Provides the later/current count narrative in the context of having been in the role "for a while": "I now lead a team of five engineers." This supports the "now" number.
Reinforces the same later count: "Leading a team of 5 engineers..." Useful for downstream confirmation.
